ariaLabel.default: Reference table with 16 captures. Drag a capture to move it, drag the canvas to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom. Arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom, zero fits all.

propDocs.cards: Array of {title, cat, catname, file, dark, light, alt, u, v, s, ar, k, hk, cx, cy} in capture order. u and v place the piece on the loose board (0 to 1), s is its size, ar its aspect ratio. k, hk, cx and cy crop the 2400 by 1500 source picture: k is the zoom across, hk the zoom down, cx and cy the centre of the crop. dark and light are the 1024 wide pictures; the .w2400. twin is loaded when zoomed in. Equal dark and light addresses use one picture for both themes.
propDocs.categories: Array of {id, label, align, top, topPhone?}. id matches the cat of the cards, align is start, center or end, top is a percentage of the board height.
propDocs.hint: Text at the bottom right, hidden below 1180 px wide.
propDocs.ariaLabel: Screen reader description of the canvas.
propDocs.metaSuffix: Appended to the category in the full size viewer caption.
propDocs.labels: Object of button and dialog texts: loose, tidy, tidyLayout, fit, fitAll, zoomOut, zoomIn, close, viewer, previous, next, capture, local, tags.

fallback: The poster shows the loose board at rest. Reduced motion draws the settled layout at once, runs no coasting or tilt, and keeps every control usable.
